readings: For each account, average its transaction amounts (`trans.amount`), and assign the account to the region (`district.A3`) of its branch district (`account.district_id`). For each region, average those per-account averages to get the region's figure. For the regions whose figure is above the average across all regions, show each region, its figure, how much it exceeds the all-region average, and its figure divided by the average of the regions' figures. Don't round anything.
queries:
WITH acct AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, a.district_id, AVG(t.amount) AS acct_avg
    FROM trans t
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY t.account_id, a.district_id
),
region AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(acct.acct_avg) AS region_avg
    FROM acct
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = acct.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(region_avg) AS overall_avg FROM region
)
SELECT r.region,
       r.region_avg,
       r.region_avg - o.overall_avg AS excess,
       r.region_avg / o.overall_avg AS ratio
FROM region r, overall o
WHERE r.region_avg > o.overall_avg;
